result.description: FINTRAC-registered FX forensic audit layer: compares a bank's applied FX rate to live mid-market, returning FX score, spread and hidden fees via API and MCP.
result.auth_detail: API key (prefix ipx_live_) sent as Authorization: Bearer; OpenAPI also lists Supabase JWT. Generated in the iPayX dashboard. Some MCP tools are public with per-IP rate limits and need no key.
result.access_detail: Keyed REST API sits behind paid API plans: pricing page lists Developer $99/mo (100 audits, sandbox), Starter $499, Pro $1,499, Scale $4,999. I found no free key tier. Each end user would need their own paid key. A small unauthenticated MCP/REST surface (3 free audits per IP per month, free rate lookup) exists, but it is IP rate-limited and unfit for per-user connections. No app review or partner status is required to connect. I could only read the pricing and API docs pages as client-rendered JS, not as server text, so the plan details come from the page bundle.
result.api_notes: OpenAPI 3.1 documents three endpoints: /fx-audit-engine (audit of up to 500 transactions), /fetch-spot-rate and /roi-calculator. The server is a Supabase edge function host, and llms.txt also lists api.ipayx.ai/functions/v1/fx-audit-engine. Docs mention webhooks. The API does a single FX-audit job, so it is narrow.
result.blocker: Narrow API (about 3 endpoints) with keys sold only on paid plans from $99/mo. Only a free, IP-limited public tier works without a key. The docs are client-rendered and there is no standalone developer reference.
